items.text: **The event-stream reader remembers where its last scan stopped** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/stream.rs:612`), per `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/an-event-stream-reparses-its-buffer-per-read.json`. `event_at` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/stream.rs:824`) and `line_at` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/http/stream.rs:723`) scan from offset 0 on every `pull()`, so one event arriving in small reads is O(n²/read size). Ladder `http-client/event-size.nvs`. Rule: the goal's base rule.

**A regex cache hit runs the memory check too** (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/regex.rs:972`), per `data/gaps/nvs-stdlib/a-regex-cache-hit-skips-the-memory-check.json` — a different file set, so take it only with room to spare. Correctness first: a cold and a warm core must give the same answer, and `prepared` belongs in the key. Rule: the goal's base rule.
